basis: Configuration commits, not installation or activation dates. Baseline means already present in the earliest recorded snapshot. Open periods describe source selection at HEAD; pending edits are undated.

events.title: Ephemeral root and Preservation already present
events.detail: Tmpfs root, encrypted Btrfs and explicit persistence are a baseline, not a proven adoption date.

events.title: Default kernel set → latest kernel set
events.detail: Hardware-support policy changed; this does not identify a numeric kernel version.

events.title: Operator cheatsheet added
events.detail: CHEATSHEET.md preceded the interactive guide.

events.title: Niri + Noctalia introduced
events.detail: GNOME remained available while the new desktop was integrated.

events.title: DNSCrypt becomes the system DNS path
events.detail: NetworkManager stops owning DNS; resolver configuration was corrected the following day.

events.title: Persistence narrowed; integrity maintenance added
events.detail: Monthly scrub and SMART added. Retained logs changed again later; always consult the current persistence declaration.

events.title: Zen → LibreWolf
events.detail: Browser module selection changes; personal usage dates remain unknown.

events.title: Niri becomes the sole desktop session
events.detail: GNOME session removed; GNOME/GTK applications and integration remain.

events.title: Jovian integration → standard Steam
events.detail: Simpler desktop gaming ownership without a dedicated Jovian session.

events.title: DNS providers selected explicitly
events.detail: Cloudflare and Scaleway replace discovery across the full catalog.

events.title: Flat single-host/user layout established
events.detail: shadow/ directly selects modules; no extra profiles layer is needed for one host/user.

events.title: LibreWolf → Brave as default browser
events.detail: Program imports and web MIME defaults change; not a claim about exclusive usage.

events.title: Niri files become store-managed
events.detail: Home Manager deployment replaces direct out-of-store links.

events.title: micro defaults → Helix/Zed
events.detail: EDITOR and VISUAL change; this is not their first installation date.

events.title: zram added before disk swap
events.detail: Compressed RAM swap reduces disk pressure; disk swap remains overflow.

events.title: COSMIC app integration → GNOME apps
events.detail: An application-stack change, not a COSMIC compositor migration.

events.title: Noctalia v5.1.0 → v5.2.0
events.detail: Repository release-pin update, not the upstream release or activation date.

events.title: Noctalia v5.2.0 → v5.2.1
events.detail: Historical flake selection. The pending worktree removes that input; no adoption date is assigned to an uncommitted change.

events.title: Interactive guide replaces former docs
events.detail: Offline lessons, app catalog and simulations become the operator entry point.

events.title: DNS/IPv6 alignment and narrower service exposure
events.detail: Loopback resolver alignment, Kavita LAN opening removed, native NetworkManager VPN workflow documented.

periods.title: Preservation already selected
periods.detail: Adoption predates or equals the first snapshot. No Impermanence-to-Preservation migration is evidenced.

periods.title: Power-profiles-daemon baseline
periods.detail: Present in the first snapshot and committed HEAD. No recorded TLP, TuneD or auto-cpufreq migration.

periods.title: GNOME + Niri transition
periods.detail: Niri/Noctalia introduced alongside GNOME; GNOME session removed at the endpoint.

periods.title: LibreWolf selected
periods.detail: Zen replaced at the start; Brave becomes default at the end. Ranges are commit boundaries, not usage logs.

periods.title: Brave selected as default
periods.detail: Open-ended at reviewed source state; running browser preferences require verification.

periods.title: COSMIC application integration
periods.detail: GNOME applications replace these integrations; desktop compositor remained Niri.

periods.title: Noctalia v5.2.0 pin
periods.detail: v5.1.0 → v5.2.0 is known; the earlier v5.1.0 start date is not established here.

periods.title: Noctalia v5.2.1 historical input pin
periods.detail: Valid for committed HEAD. Pending flake edits remove the input; inspect the effective shell package before treating this as a live version.
